title: ABAP Analyser Planner Digest
description: The deterministic, size-capped STRICT projection of analyser-findings.json that the planner grounds on instead of the raw findings document (arch spec §15.8, gap #20 — scales to 100K LOC). Used compilation-unit objects only, each reduced to {object, grade, successor?, effort_tier}, plus the Top-N findings by severity. Written to specs/brownfield/planner-digest.json beside the findings report. Carries NO wall-clock field so it is byte-identical across runs over the same bundle; the JS validator validate-planner-digest.js mirrors this schema and consumers fail-closed on an invalid digest.

digest_version.description: Semver of the digest contract shape (independent of the findings schema_version).

schema_version.description: Provenance: the schema_version of the analyser-findings document this digest projects.

package.description: The custom-code package scanned (from the findings doc).

source_system.description: The SAP source system identity (from the findings doc).

source_hash.description: Provenance: the findings doc source_hash (§7) — deterministic, ties the digest to its findings run.

object_count.description: Total used compilation-unit objects BEFORE the cap — object_count > objects.length signals a truncated (size-capped) digest.

objects_included.description: Objects retained after the PLANNER_DIGEST_MAX_OBJECTS cap.

finding_count.description: Total findings BEFORE the cap — finding_count > findings.length signals truncation.

findings_included.description: Findings retained after the PLANNER_DIGEST_MAX_FINDINGS cap.

objects.description: Used compilation-unit objects (method/form member nodes excluded), customer (Z/Y) first then by PageRank importance, projected to the §15.8 shape. A strict subset of graph.nodes in analyser-findings.json.

object.description: Object name — exists as a graph node in analyser-findings.json.

successor.description: Released successor / modernization target (node modernization_target); omitted when the node names none.

effort_tier.description: Node-level effort tier (distinct from the plan S/M/L/XL effort).

findings.description: Top-N findings by severity (priority-1 first), a strict projection of findings[] in analyser-findings.json.

family.description: Finding family (released-api, modification, invariant, ...) — the planner routes on it.
